headline: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 return after US lifts export controls
summary: Anthropic will begin restoring access to its consumer-facing Fable 5 and enterprise Mythos 5 models tomorrow, weeks after the Trump administration imposed export controls over jailbreak concerns.
details: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models are set to return, with the Department of Commerce lifting export controls. Anthropic announced on X that it plans to begin restoring access to users tomorrow.

The models were sidelined in early June after the Trump administration issued an ultimatum and an export control directive. This move was prompted by concerns over potential jailbreaks of the technology, restricting access for foreign nationals.

The directive meant that non-US members of enterprise client companies and even many of Anthropic’s own foreign national employees were disallowed from using either Mythos 5 or Fable 5. This happened shortly after Anthropic had spent a week hyping both models.

The Trump administration had previously greenlit Mythos 5's return, but only to a pre-approved list of organizations under similar rules to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 rollout. The initial export control came at a critical time for Anthropic, which is preparing for an IPO.

headline: ChatGPT personal finance features expand to all US Plus customers
summary: OpenAI's personal finance features for ChatGPT Plus are now available to all eligible customers in the U.S., offering AI-powered insights for financial management.
details: OpenAI has officially expanded its personal finance features for ChatGPT Plus subscribers across the United States. This update, rolled out on June 30, 2026, makes AI-driven financial assistance accessible to a wider user base.

The feature aims to provide users with personalized insights and tools to manage their finances more effectively. It leverages ChatGPT's advanced AI capabilities to analyze financial data and offer guidance on various financial topics.
